einzeiler: Why true leadership means prioritizing collective progress over speed.
kurzfassung: John Maxwell reflects on the power of teamwork during a trip to Johannesburg. He explains that true leaders deliberately sacrifice speed to ensure everyone crosses the finish line together. Achieving greatness requires moving forward with others rather than trying to accomplish everything alone.
stichpunkte: Teamwork is essential for achieving true greatness.
A memorable sign in Johannesburg sparked a reflection on speed versus distance.
The common temptation is to work alone because it feels faster.
Effective leaders intentionally avoid trying to be the fastest.
Leaders never cross the finish line by themselves.
True leadership means waiting until everyone reaches the goal together.
Success is unacceptable if followers do not share in the victory.
One is considered too small a number to accomplish great things.
